opportunities.title: Research Awards (Research and Travel Grants)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards will not be made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree. Retrospective applications will not be considered.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants of £500 to £5,000 to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, across archaeology, art history, architectural and buildings history, material culture items and assemblages, the history of collecting, and intellectual enquiry into the human past.
